trial_court: Family Court, Berhampur, Ganjam (C.P. No.156 of 2018)
case_name: Chitra Rath vs Amresh Pattanaik — TRP(C) No.292 OF 2019
facts_of_case: Petitioner-wife seeks transfer of C.P. No.156 of 2018 from Family Court to Civil Judge (Sr. Division), Parlakhemundi due to harassment by opposite party-husband.

legal_principles.principle: The interest of justice would be best served when a party can participate in the proceeding.
legal_principles.held: It is further contended that in the event, C.P. No.156 of 2018 pending in the court of learned Judge, Family Court, Berhampur, Ganjam is transferred to the court of learned Civil Judge (Sr. Division), Parlakhemundi, Gajapati, the interest of justice would be best served so that the petitioner can participate in the proceeding.

legal_principles.principle: A party may withdraw a case if they are being harassed.
legal_principles.held: It is also contended that the opposite party, instead of participating in the proceeding, withdrew the said MAT 32 of 2016 on 09.04.2018 and filed a fresh C.P. No.156 of 2018 before the learned Judge, Family Court, Berhampur only to cause harassment to the petitioner.

outcome.final_order: The court directs the learned Judge, Family Court, Berhampur to transmit C.P. No.156 of 2018 to the court of learned Civil Judge (Sr. Division), Parlakhemundi.

use_for_drafting: drafting a transfer petition in family court
advising on jurisdictional issues in divorce cases
preparing an appeal against a family court order
